notes.title: Wooden pod and the traps
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33230117/97f8c3bbfc9b763e82def929d19959ae7171fd21.png[/img]Hello, the new map wooden pod and the traps has been added into the game. And there is a new character with the watermelon hat.

notes.title: New Scene Evil Jail
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33230117/6e8ace29eacf89064949c0b0a3ee845d55c4962d.png[/img]New Scene Evil Jail has been added into the random scene queue in game. It is dark style scene with cartoon arts and pole axes has been added into this scene. Some UI bugs has been fixed.

notes.title: Russian and German
notes.content: Game GUI support Russian and German now, and a new character had been add into the game

notes.title: Brandishing and fighting
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33230117/3e549bea37496bca4afeff28e44c83fec5d82cb4.jpg[/img]

Game has been redesigned and now player can brandishing the hands and the weapons to attack the others with their ricecaker ragdolls. Redraw all stuff in the game with new cartoon style arts. Rebuild all scenes and add three new scenes into the game. 

Support using the joysticks to play game. And a new local multiplayes mode has been added.
Add tutorial mode for beginners and let the AI robots more weaker.
Fix the bugs in LAN mode and reimplement the workflow of the game.
